notes.title: 0.16.2 Content
notes.content:
In the next update, in addition to a few minor bug fixes, I'll address two things that are in need of some love: Bjorn has lost his skills and gotten Saras skills temporarily due to the combat rework.

His skill Feint affected the old resistance system, where resistances were set in stone per enemy type. This meant that all Boars had the same resistances, and Bjorn was able to manipulate them during combat. With the rework those resistances were removed and replaced by defence points.

The new Feint skill will manipulate those defence points instead. I have them designed on paper, and will begin working on them now.

The other is one of my arch enemies - the chest equipment popup (known as the Swap Popup)[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34146237/452d70594b9829a3513b0e69cbf75a1afee297cc.gif[/img]

As you can see, players are able to click multiple times, and more than once lets players have said something like "wow, look how much items are in the chest" and later realised "oh, it was just swapping back and forth between two items".

I've reworked this popup so many times, and it never turns out well.. This time I'll spend some additional time making it more intuitive and easier to grasp. Hopefully this will remove this issue completely.


Cheers,
Jocce

Wanted to celebrate one year of Early Access with a discount for a week!

It has been a really stressful year, but the game has come really far during this time. I've been working on the game full time for two years, and when the EA release hit, I was head hunted for a job that I had to take to make ends meet. At the same time, we got pregnant. So, this Early Access year has been full of daytime work, indie dev during nights, while also wading in diapers and puke.

Much love,
Jocce

notes.title: Health System Test
notes.content:
The combat system in Necken was designed to be simple, strategic and light - not taking too much focus from the main aspect of the game.

Over time, I've gotten comments and feedback about the combat maybe being too simple, and I've felt this myself as well. Even if there's 1000 things I wish to add to Necken, I only have so much time.

But, I've decided to make a combat update test. The design is finished, and I've outlined all the aspects of the game that are going to be affected by this change. So far it looks solid, and still stays true to the core idea of the combat system. It will not be reworked, but extended, adding more depth to it.

I will start building all the neccessary changes and cover most of the affected systems, and will hopefully be able to roll out this test on the development branch pretty soon. I would love to hear your thoughts on the change, and if you think it's a good or bad direction.

The updated combat system will have another aspect the player needs to take into consideration before choosing attacks - enemy damage.
Right now, 1 charge is consumed from the attack source you chose, and it will stay the same. However, you will also have a normal health bar to take into account.

I'll keep you informed - here, on Twitter, and in the Discord chat. Please join if you're interested in staying up to date, or want to share your thoughts on the game: https://discord.gg/JGV5Gkg

Cheers,
Jocce

notes.title: Early Access release!
notes.content:
A big day for Necken - finally it's out in the open, available for others to play. Feels really great and the feedback has been awesome so far!

The current game is shorter than people will expect I think - meaning there's not much replayability once you've completed the whole game. These next couple of updates will address this issue - adding more characters, more unlockables and overall just adding "more".

Next up is unlockable characters. The basic system is working, so there shouldn't be too long until it can be playtested in the beta branch.
